title: Agent CI kit project config
description: Your project's toolchain and commands, read by the kit's workflows and session hook. See docs/PROJECT-CONFIG.md.

command.description: One command, no shell operators. A trailing `:*` allows any arguments (Claude Code permission syntax).

toolchain.description: Runtimes to install on the runner before anything else runs. Any combination; empty means the runner image already has what you need.

install.description: Installs dependencies once the toolchain is set up. Runs in CI before the agent starts and in fresh cloud sessions. Empty or absent: nothing to install.

checks.description: The mechanical checks, in order. pr-checks.yml runs each one; agents must pass all of them before pushing.

agent_commands.description: Extra commands agents may run in CI, beyond `checks` and git. Anything not listed here or in `checks` is denied in a headless run.

dependency_files.description: Manifests and lockfiles. The fix agent may only change them when the bug is in a dependency.

protected_paths.description: Path prefixes an unattended agent may never change, on top of .github/, .claude/ and .env* which are always protected. The fix workflow refuses to open a PR that touches one.

image.description: Container build for build-image.yml. Omit it, and delete that workflow, if you do not ship an image.

inputs.description: git pathspecs for everything that ends up in the image. Their content hash decides whether a build is needed; `:!:` excludes.
